tested: tested in the real Blender interface on 5.0.1, 5.1.1 and 5.1.2 on Windows, including 10,000-step sessions and files from beta 1.
known_issues: Only tested on Windows so far, and only on Blender 5.0 and 5.1 in the real interface. Blender 4.2 to 4.5 should work but I haven't run them yet.
Multires and Dyntopo aren't recorded. Recording pauses on those objects and the tab says why.
Modifiers, shape keys, vertex groups, weight paint and materials aren't part of the history.
After Hindsight moves the mesh in Sculpt or Vertex Paint Mode, Blender's own undo can't go back past that point. Hindsight reverses it and asks you to use Ctrl+Z or the slider.
Movie Mode: if playback crosses a remesh while the object is in Sculpt Mode, that frame shows the old topology for a moment. Render from Object Mode.
If you sculpt from an earlier step and that drops the step set as the morph target, the target is cleared. Set it again.
Linked duplicates share one history, because they share one mesh.
